title: Level 1: Lets Know States of Matter
subtitle: New curriculum coming soon

title: Level 2: Chemical Foundations
subtitle: Basic safety, matter, and laboratory skills

sections.title: Relationship of P, E, N, Z, A
sections.description: Learn how protons, electrons, neutrons, atomic number, and mass connect.

sections.title: Bohr Atomic Model
sections.description: Explore orbits, electron energy transitions (absorption/emission), spectra, and angular momentum.

sections.title: Metric Measurements
sections.description: Practice precise readings of liquid volumes, temperature, and analytical balances.

sections.title: Simple Thermal Distillation
sections.description: Set up a distillation rig to isolate pure water from a saline solution.

sections.title: Chemical vs Physical Changes
sections.description: Identify indicators of reaction: gas evolution, color shift, and precipitate.

sections.title: Paper Chromatography
sections.description: Separate ink pigments using moving phases and calculate precise Rf values.

sections.title: Conservation of Mass
sections.description: Verify that total mass remains constant during a precipitation reaction.

sections.title: Lab Clean Up & Disposal
sections.description: Learn safe neutralization of chemicals and standard laboratory waste protocol.

sections.title: Stoichiometry Calculations
sections.description: Practice balancing equations and calculating mole-to-mass conversions.

sections.title: Synthesis of Water
sections.description: Combine hydrogen and oxygen gas safely and determine the product yield.

sections.title: Double Displacement Reactions
sections.description: Observe precipitate formation when mixing different aqueous salt solutions.

sections.title: Single Displacement Activity Series
sections.description: Place various metals in acid to establish their relative chemical activity.

sections.title: Combustion Analysis
sections.description: Burn organic compounds to find their empirical and molecular formulas.

sections.title: Limiting Reactants Lab
sections.description: Determine the limiting reactant by measuring precipitate mass.

sections.title: Introduction to pH
sections.description: Understand the logarithmic scale of hydrogen ion concentration.

sections.title: Acid-Base Titration
sections.description: Use a buret to neutralize hydrochloric acid with sodium hydroxide.

sections.title: Natural Indicators
sections.description: Extract anthocyanin dye from red cabbage to test home solutions.

sections.title: Strong vs Weak Acids
sections.description: Compare dissociation constants and conductivity of different acids.

sections.title: Buffer Solutions
sections.description: Prepare a buffer system and test its resistance to pH changes.

sections.title: Salt Hydrolysis
sections.description: Predict and test the pH of aqueous solutions of various salts.

title: Level 5: States of Matter
subtitle: Gas laws, phase changes, and kinetic theory

sections.title: Boyle's Law Simulation
sections.description: Manipulate pressure and volume of a gas at constant temperature.

sections.title: Charles's Law Experiment
sections.description: Measure how temperature affects gas volume at constant pressure.

sections.title: Ideal Gas Law Problems
sections.description: Perform calculations using PV=nRT in various real-world scenarios.

sections.title: Phase Diagrams
sections.description: Analyze triple points and critical points for different substances.

sections.title: Heating Curve of Water
sections.description: Track temperature changes as ice transforms to steam.

title: Level 6: Atomic Structure
subtitle: Quantum numbers, electron configuration, and orbits

sections.title: Bohr Model Simulation
sections.description: Simulate electron orbits, absorption, and emission spectra.

sections.title: Quantum Numbers Quiz
sections.description: Master principles like Pauli Exclusion and Hund's Rules.

sections.title: Electron Configurations
sections.description: Write spectroscopic notations for transition elements.

sections.title: Flame Test Lab
sections.description: Excite metal cations to observe characteristic emission colors.

sections.title: Periodic Trends Analyzers
sections.description: Compare atomic size, ionization energy, and electronegativity.

title: Level 7: Thermodynamics
subtitle: Enthalpy, entropy, calorimetry, and free energy

sections.title: Specific Heat Calorimetry
sections.description: Identify unknown metals by measuring temperature shifts in water.

sections.title: Hess's Law Verification
sections.description: Calculate heat of reaction indirectly using step-wise equations.

sections.title: Endothermic vs Exothermic
sections.description: Perform hydration reactions and track thermal changes.

sections.title: Gibbs Free Energy
sections.description: Determine reaction spontaneity using enthalpy and entropy values.

title: Level 8: Electrochemistry
subtitle: Galvanic cells, electrolysis, and redox reactions

sections.title: Balancing Redox Reactions
sections.description: Practice half-reaction methods in acidic and basic solutions.

sections.title: Galvanic Cells Assembly
sections.description: Set up a zinc-copper cell, measure voltage, and map ion flow.

sections.title: Electrochemical Series
sections.description: Rank redox couples by standard reduction potentials.

sections.title: Electrolysis of Water
sections.description: Decompose water into oxygen and hydrogen gas using current.

sections.title: Faraday's Law of Electrolysis
sections.description: Determine mass deposition based on current magnitude and time.

sections.title: Hydrocarbon Nomenclature
sections.description: Name alkanes, alkenes, alkynes and isomers using IUPAC rules.

sections.title: Functional Groups Matching
sections.description: Identify aldehydes, ketones, esters, and carboxylic acids.

sections.title: Synthesis of Aspirin
sections.description: Acetylate salicylic acid and recrystallize the pure product.

sections.title: Esterification Reaction
sections.description: React an alcohol and acid to produce distinct fruit fragrances.

sections.title: Saponification Lab
sections.description: Hydrolyze fats with sodium hydroxide to synthesize simple soap.

sections.title: Fractional Distillation Quiz
sections.description: Test knowledge of boiling points and crude oil separations.
